records.context: Some thresholds are not offered here. Local mean and local Gaussian thresholding are not offered again: they are the Adaptive threshold mode, which runs the organelle engine's ``adaptive`` branch with a block size and an offset. Local OTSU is not offered again either: it is the "Local threshold (uneven illumination)" switch in plain Otsu mode, used by whole-image detection. Other named thresholds ignore saved Local Otsu and class-count settings; Multi-Otsu alone uses the selected class count and band in both scopes. Plain Otsu retains its legacy magnifier preprocessing, while the other thresholds use the whole-image engine on the requested extracted image region. Niblack uses ``T = m - k*s``; Sauvola uses ``T = m*(1 + k*(s/R - 1))``, where ``m`` and ``s`` are the local mean and standard deviation. The engine supplies float32 values without rescaling their range, so scikit-image's default Sauvola ``R`` is 1. These formulas are different, and changing the intensity scale can change Sauvola's result.

records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Some thresholds are not offered here. Local mean and local Gaussian thresholding are not offered again: they are the Adaptive threshold mode, which runs the organelle engine's ``adaptive`` branch with a block size and an offset. Local OTSU is not offered again either: it is the "Local threshold (uneven illumination)" switch in plain Otsu mode, used by whole-image detection. Other named thresholds ignore saved Local Otsu and class-count settings; Multi-Otsu alone uses the selected class count and band in both scopes. Plain Otsu retains its legacy magnifier preprocessing, while the other thresholds use the whole-image engine on the requested crop. Niblack uses ``T = m - k*s``; Sauvola uses ``T = m*(1 + k*(s/R - 1))``, where ``m`` and ``s`` are the local mean and standard deviation. The engine supplies float32 values without rescaling their range, so scikit-image's default Sauvola ``R`` is 1. These formulas are different, and changing the intensity scale can change Sauvola's result.
records.translation: कुछ thresholds यहाँ नहीं दिए गए हैं। Local mean और local Gaussian thresholding फिर से नहीं दिए गए: वे Adaptive threshold मोड हैं, जो organelle इंजन की ``adaptive`` शाखा को block size और offset के साथ चलाता है। Local OTSU भी फिर से नहीं दिया गया: वह साधारण Otsu मोड में "Local threshold (uneven illumination)" स्विच है, जिसका उपयोग पूरी-छवि पहचान करती है। अन्य नामित thresholds सहेजी गई Local Otsu और class-count सेटिंग्स को अनदेखा करते हैं; केवल Multi-Otsu दोनों दायरों में चुनी गई class count और band का उपयोग करता है। साधारण Otsu अपनी पुरानी magnifier preprocessing बनाए रखता है, जबकि अन्य thresholds माँगे गए crop पर whole-image इंजन का उपयोग करते हैं। Niblack ``T = m - k*s`` का उपयोग करता है; Sauvola ``T = m*(1 + k*(s/R - 1))`` का उपयोग करता है, जहाँ ``m`` और ``s`` स्थानीय माध्य और मानक विचलन हैं। इंजन float32 मान उनकी रेंज को पुनः स्केल किए बिना देता है, इसलिए scikit-image का डिफ़ॉल्ट Sauvola ``R`` 1 है। ये सूत्र अलग हैं, और तीव्रता स्केल बदलने से Sauvola का परिणाम बदल सकता है।

records.context: the Gaussian blur before the maxima are found, in pixels. This is separate from the image enhancement chain's denoise, which has already run by the time a detector sees the image: the blur that gives one object one centre is usually much stronger than the blur wanted for measuring the object's edge, and the propagation measures the edge on the same blurred image. Leave the chain's denoise off unless the microscope field of view is genuinely noisy, or the two blurs compound.

records.translation: maxima खोजे जाने से पहले Gaussian blur, पिक्सेल में। यह image enhancement chain के denoise से अलग है, जो detector के छवि देखने तक पहले ही चल चुका होता है: एक ऑब्जेक्ट को एक केंद्र देने वाला blur आमतौर पर ऑब्जेक्ट का किनारा मापने के लिए चाहिए blur से बहुत अधिक प्रबल होता है, और propagation उसी blurred छवि पर किनारा मापता है। जब तक फ़ील्ड वास्तव में noisy न हो, chain का denoise बंद रखें, अन्यथा दोनों blur मिलकर बढ़ जाते हैं।

records.context: Found through ``findChildren`` rather than by walking the menu bar's actions and calling ``QAction.menu()``. That reading is the obvious one and it does not survive on PySide6 6.11: the QMenu wrapper it returns is only valid while the QAction wrapper it came off is alive, so the menu went stale the moment this function returned — "Internal C++ object (PySide6.QtWidgets.QMenu) already deleted" on the very next line — and keeping the owners alive as attributes segfaulted during the next event dispatch instead. ``findChildren`` hands back children the menu bar owns in C++, which stay valid for as long as the window does.

records.context: Those two lines, in that order, are reproduced exactly by ``tests/qt/test_gc_runs_on_the_gui_thread.py`` with no spaCR code involved at all: build a QObject that owns a *executing* QTimer, drop it into a reference CYCLE so only the collector can free it, then call ``gc.collect()`` from a background execution unit. records.source: Those two lines, in that order, are reproduced exactly by ``tests/qt/test_gc_runs_on_the_gui_thread.py`` with no spaCR code involved at all: build a QObject that owns a *running* QTimer, drop it into a reference CYCLE so only the collector can free it, then call ``gc.collect()`` from a worker thread. The collector runs the destructor **on whichever thread it happens to be running on**, and Qt cannot stop a timer from there.
records.translation: वे दो पंक्तियाँ, उसी क्रम में, ``tests/qt/test_gc_runs_on_the_gui_thread.py`` द्वारा बिना किसी spaCR कोड के ठीक-ठीक दोहराई जाती हैं: एक QObject बनाएँ जो एक *चल रहे* QTimer का स्वामी हो, उसे एक reference CYCLE (चक्र) में डालें ताकि केवल collector उसे मुक्त कर सके, फिर एक वर्कर थ्रेड से ``gc.collect()`` कॉल करें। collector destructor को **उसी थ्रेड पर चलाता है जिस पर वह संयोग से चल रहा हो**, और Qt वहाँ से टाइमर नहीं रोक सकता।

records.context: ``QPixmap.scaled(w, h, ...)`` takes DEVICE pixels but every caller in a GUI means LOGICAL ones -- the size the picture should occupy on application view. On a display with a device pixel ratio of 2, which is every retina Mac and plenty of Windows and Linux machines, Qt then stretches that logical bitmap across twice as many real pixels in each direction: a 200 px render blown up to 400 px, from a 3334 px source. The picture is not low-resolution; the scaling threw the resolution away.
records.label: spacr.qt.hidpi#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: ``QPixmap.scaled(w, h, ...)`` takes DEVICE pixels but every caller in a GUI means LOGICAL ones -- the size the picture should occupy on screen. On a display with a device pixel ratio of 2, which is every retina Mac and plenty of Windows and Linux machines, Qt then stretches that logical bitmap across twice as many real pixels in each direction: a 200 px render blown up to 400 px, from a 3334 px source. The picture is not low-resolution; the scaling threw the resolution away.
records.translation: ``QPixmap.scaled(w, h, ...)`` DEVICE (डिवाइस) पिक्सेल लेता है, लेकिन GUI में हर कॉलर का आशय LOGICAL (तार्किक) पिक्सेल से होता है -- वह आकार जो चित्र को स्क्रीन पर घेरना चाहिए। 2 के device pixel ratio वाले डिस्प्ले पर, जो हर retina Mac और कई Windows और Linux मशीनें हैं, Qt उस तार्किक bitmap को हर दिशा में दोगुने वास्तविक पिक्सेलों पर फैला देता है: 200 px का render 400 px तक बड़ा, 3334 px के स्रोत से। चित्र कम रिज़ॉल्यूशन का नहीं है; स्केलिंग ने रिज़ॉल्यूशन फेंक दिया।

records.context: What is live instead. An explicit ``QWidget.setFont`` *does* beat the application sheet's ``font-size`` -- it is the same escape hatch that lets a per-widget sheet win -- and it costs one font assignment and one relayout rather than a global unpolish/repolish. So a notch snapshots each visible widget's font once, then re-scales every widget from that snapshot by the ratio the wheel has travelled. The role hierarchy survives because each widget is scaled from its own baseline: a 22 px title and a 13 px caption stay in proportion without this module knowing which is which.

records.translation: WHAT IS LIVE INSTEAD (इसके बजाय क्या लाइव है)। एक स्पष्ट ``QWidget.setFont`` एप्लिकेशन शीट के ``font-size`` पर *भारी* पड़ता है -- यह वही escape hatch है जो प्रति-विजेट शीट को जीतने देता है -- और इसकी लागत एक वैश्विक unpolish/repolish के बजाय एक फ़ॉन्ट असाइनमेंट और एक relayout है। इसलिए एक notch हर दिखाई देने वाले विजेट के फ़ॉन्ट का एक बार snapshot लेता है, फिर हर विजेट को उस snapshot से उस अनुपात में पुनः स्केल करता है जितना wheel घूमा है। भूमिका पदानुक्रम बना रहता है क्योंकि हर विजेट अपनी आधार रेखा से स्केल होता है: 22 px का शीर्षक और 13 px का कैप्शन अनुपात में रहते हैं, बिना इस मॉड्यूल के यह जाने कि कौन-सा कौन है।

records.context: What is not live, and why that was accepted. Every size the font scale pins from Python -- row heights, column widths, icon sizes, tile geometry, all of :func:`spacr.qt.preferences.scaled_px` -- moves only when the stylesheet is rebuilt, and that is the 587 ms number. The choice made: "Text live, spacing on release." Text follows the wheel; the spacing around it catches up in one step when the wheel stops or Z comes up. It is a deliberate compromise, not an oversight, and it is why the settle exists.

records.context: Records produced *while* a console panel is mid-write are dropped. Every ``ConsolePanel`` in the process subscribes to :attr:`record_ready`, so without this a record logged from inside ``append_stdout`` — which the function-trace profile hook emits on entry to every spaCR function — comes straight back into the same widget. ``_StdoutBlock.append`` answers it with a nested ``setPlainText``, and the inner call destroys the QTextDocument's frames while the outer one is still inside ``QTextDocumentPrivate::clear()``: a segfault, gdb'd to ``QTextFrame::~QTextFrame``.
records.label: spacr.qt.logging_util.QtLogHandler.emit#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Records produced *while* a console panel is mid-write are dropped. Every ``ConsolePanel`` in the process subscribes to :attr:`record_ready`, so without this a record logged from inside ``append_stdout`` — which the function-trace profile hook emits on entry to every spaCR function — comes straight back into the same widget. ``_StdoutBlock.append`` answers it with a nested ``setPlainText``, and the inner call destroys the QTextDocument's frames while the outer one is still inside ``QTextDocumentPrivate::clear()``: a segfault, gdb'd to ``QTextFrame::~QTextFrame``.
records.translation: किसी console पैनल के लिखने के बीच *बनने वाले* रिकॉर्ड छोड़ दिए जाते हैं। प्रोसेस का हर ``ConsolePanel`` :attr:`record_ready` को सब्सक्राइब करता है, इसलिए इसके बिना ``append_stdout`` के भीतर से लॉग किया गया रिकॉर्ड — जिसे function-trace profile hook हर spaCR फ़ंक्शन में प्रवेश पर भेजता है — सीधे उसी विजेट में लौट आता है। ``_StdoutBlock.append`` उसका उत्तर नेस्टेड ``setPlainText`` से देता है, और भीतरी कॉल QTextDocument के frames नष्ट कर देता है जबकि बाहरी कॉल अभी ``QTextDocumentPrivate::clear()`` के भीतर है: एक segfault, जिसे gdb से ``QTextFrame::~QTextFrame`` तक खोजा गया।

records.context: Two phases:
records.label: spacr.qt.maturity.apply#1

records.source: Two phases:
records.translation: दो चरण:

records.context: 1. :data:`PROMOTIONS` lists applications that were assessed and moved. Applying it repeatedly is safe, and it never *moves an application to a lower stage*. If another component promoted an application further, it stays there. This table represents one assessment; loading it later must not undo a newer assessment. 2. Each registered application absent from all assessment tables and without its own line receives :data:`UNASSESSED_STAGE`. This prevents a new module from inheriting ``stable`` merely because no entry exists. The function writes only empty entries, so it cannot override an author, a plugin, or step 1.
records.label: spacr.qt.maturity.apply#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: 1. :data:`PROMOTIONS` — the apps somebody assessed and moved. Idempotent, and it never *demotes*: a module some other code has already promoted further than this table says stays where it is. That matters because the table is a snapshot of one assessment, and the next assessment should not be silently undone by re-importing this module. 2. Every registered app that is in none of the assessment tables and has no line of its own is written in as :data:`UNASSESSED_STAGE`. This is what stops a new module inheriting ``stable`` from the absence of an entry — see the module docstring. It only ever writes where there is nothing, so it cannot overrule an author, a plugin, or phase 1.
records.translation: 1. :data:`PROMOTIONS` — वे apps जिनका किसी ने आकलन किया और उन्हें आगे बढ़ाया। idempotent है, और कभी *नीचे नहीं करता*: जिस मॉड्यूल को किसी अन्य कोड ने इस टेबल से आगे पहले ही बढ़ा दिया है, वह वहीं रहता है। यह इसलिए महत्वपूर्ण है क्योंकि टेबल एक आकलन का snapshot है, और इस मॉड्यूल को फिर से इम्पोर्ट करने से अगला आकलन चुपचाप पलटना नहीं चाहिए। 2. हर पंजीकृत app जो किसी भी आकलन टेबल में नहीं है और जिसकी अपनी कोई पंक्ति नहीं है, उसे :data:`UNASSESSED_STAGE` के रूप में लिखा जाता है। यही किसी नए मॉड्यूल को एंट्री के अभाव से ``stable`` विरासत में लेने से रोकता है — मॉड्यूल docstring देखें। यह केवल वहीं लिखता है जहाँ कुछ नहीं है, इसलिए यह किसी लेखक, plugin, या चरण 1 को रद्द नहीं कर सकता।

records.context: A separate window, not the main one made full application view. Hiding spaCR's own widgets and restoring them afterwards means remembering what was visible, what had focus, which docks were open and what the splitters were set to -- and getting any of it wrong leaves the user's layout rearranged by something that was meant to be a screensaver. A window of its own has nothing to restore: it is closed and the application is exactly as it was.

Hiding spaCR's own widgets and restoring them afterwards means remembering what was visible, what had focus, which docks were open and what the splitters were set to -- and getting any of it wrong leaves the user's layout rearranged by something that was meant to be a screensaver. A window of its own has nothing to restore: it is closed and the application is exactly as it was.

records.context: **Qt Multimedia is touched only on the main GUI execution path.** :class:`_SoundPlayer` owns ``QMediaDevices`` and every ``QSoundEffect`` and lives where the application's event loop does; the dedicated ``QThread`` keeps the part that is genuinely slow, which is synthesizing a sound set (:class:`_SoundRenderer`, numpy and file writes, nothing from Qt Multimedia). Connecting to the sound server is slow -- 354 ms measured on a PipeWire workstation -- so it is made once, on an idle timer after sound is switched on (:meth:`SoundEngine._warm`), and its duration is logged. Playing an already loaded sound is ``play()``, which returns at once: 0.007-0.014 ms on the main GUI execution path against the real stack.
records.label: spacr.qt.sound#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Qt Multimedia is touched only on the GUI thread.** :class:`_SoundPlayer` owns ``QMediaDevices`` and every ``QSoundEffect`` and lives where the application's event loop does; the dedicated ``QThread`` keeps the part that is genuinely slow, which is synthesizing a sound set (:class:`_SoundRenderer`, numpy and file writes, nothing from Qt Multimedia). Connecting to the sound server is slow -- 354 ms measured on a PipeWire workstation -- so it is made once, on an idle timer after sound is switched on (:meth:`SoundEngine._warm`), and its duration is logged. Playing an already loaded sound is ``play()``, which returns at once: 0.007-0.014 ms on the GUI thread against the real stack.
records.translation: **Qt Multimedia को केवल GUI थ्रेड पर छुआ जाता है।** :class:`_SoundPlayer` ``QMediaDevices`` और हर ``QSoundEffect`` का स्वामी है और वहीं रहता है जहाँ एप्लिकेशन का event loop है; समर्पित ``QThread`` वह भाग रखता है जो वास्तव में धीमा है, अर्थात sound set का संश्लेषण (:class:`_SoundRenderer`, numpy और फ़ाइल लेखन, Qt Multimedia से कुछ नहीं)। sound server से जुड़ना धीमा है -- एक PipeWire वर्कस्टेशन पर 354 ms मापा गया -- इसलिए यह एक बार, ध्वनि चालू होने के बाद idle टाइमर पर किया जाता है (:meth:`SoundEngine._warm`), और इसकी अवधि लॉग की जाती है। पहले से लोड ध्वनि बजाना ``play()`` है, जो तुरंत लौटता है: वास्तविक stack पर GUI थ्रेड पर 0.007-0.014 ms।

records.context: The rule follows from a crash. Building the effects on the audio independent execution path instead does move the connection off the main GUI execution path -- but Qt Multimedia's device handling belongs to the independent execution path that owns the event loop, so with the FFmpeg backend it enables socket notifiers from the wrong independent execution path. Reopening Preferences with sound on then segfaults, or wedges the interface with an empty Preferences frame until it is force quit.
records.label: spacr.qt.sound#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The rule follows from a crash. Building the effects on the audio thread instead does move the connection off the GUI thread -- but Qt Multimedia's device handling belongs to the thread that owns the event loop, so with the FFmpeg backend it enables socket notifiers from the wrong thread. Reopening Preferences with sound on then segfaults, or wedges the interface with an empty Preferences frame until it is force quit.
records.translation: यह नियम एक क्रैश से निकला। effects को audio थ्रेड पर बनाने से कनेक्शन GUI थ्रेड से हट तो जाता है -- लेकिन Qt Multimedia का device प्रबंधन उस थ्रेड का है जो event loop का स्वामी है, इसलिए FFmpeg backend के साथ यह गलत थ्रेड से socket notifiers सक्षम करता है। फिर ध्वनि चालू रहते Preferences दोबारा खोलने पर segfault होता है, या force quit किए जाने तक इंटरफ़ेस एक खाली Preferences frame के साथ अटका रहता है।

records.translation: यहाँ तीन स्वतंत्र बचाव उपाय दिए गए हैं, उसी क्रम में जिसमें वे चलते हैं। हर एक अनियंत्रित फैलाव को अलग बिंदु पर पकड़ता है, और हर एक को बंद किया जा सकता है:

records.context: 1. **Directional runaway detection and trimming** — :func:`trim_directional_runaway` measures flood width along scanlines extending from the seed. A sustained abrupt expansion marks a leak, and pixels beyond that position are removed. Detection at this stage enables the following two refinements. 2. **Intensity-constrained reflooding** — :func:`wand_region` performs a binary search for the highest tested tolerance that does not trigger runaway detection. The resulting connected region replaces the straight-line directional cut. 3. **Gradient-based boundary refinement** — :func:`taper_region_to_intensity` applies a watershed to a smoothed intensity gradient within a configurable band, moving the provisional boundary toward a nearby image edge.
records.label: spacr.qt.wand_rescue#3

records.translation: 1. **दिशात्मक अनियंत्रित फैलाव की पहचान और कटाई-छँटाई** — :func:`trim_directional_runaway` seed से निकलने वाली scanlines के साथ flood की चौड़ाई मापता है। लगातार अचानक विस्तार एक रिसाव को चिह्नित करता है, और उस स्थिति से आगे के पिक्सेल हटा दिए जाते हैं। इस चरण की पहचान अगले दो सुधारों को सक्षम करती है। 2. **तीव्रता-सीमित पुनः flooding** — :func:`wand_region` उच्चतम परखी गई tolerance के लिए binary search करता है जो अनियंत्रित फैलाव की पहचान को सक्रिय नहीं करती। परिणामी जुड़ा हुआ क्षेत्र सीधी-रेखा वाले दिशात्मक कट का स्थान लेता है। 3. **gradient-आधारित सीमा सुधार** — :func:`taper_region_to_intensity` एक कॉन्फ़िगर करने योग्य पट्टी के भीतर smoothed intensity gradient पर watershed लागू करता है, अस्थायी सीमा को पास के छवि किनारे की ओर ले जाते हुए।

records.context: Qt normally destroys a widget tree with its parent. pyqtgraph context menus are an exception: ``PlotItem`` and ``ViewBox`` intentionally create them as top-level windows and keep them through Python references. records.context: A view is one visit to one application view: it begins when the application view is shown (:meth:`begin_view`, from its ``showEvent``) and ends when it is hidden because the user went to another application view (:meth:`end_view`, from its ``hideEvent``). Pins last for the view: returning to the application view with its live preview still open collapses the surroundings again, which is what a fresh arrival at that layout would get.

records.context: The body's own visibility stays under its owner's control. The fold hides an inner holder, never the body, so unfolding cannot show a panel its owner hid or build a panel that is built on first show. The other way round, the section follows its body: while the owner keeps the body hidden the whole section -- heading included -- is hidden too, and it comes back when the owner shows the body. Only the body's hidden flag is read for that, so nothing is shown, measured or built to find out.

records.context: ``QColorDialog.getColor`` defaults to the *platform's* colour chooser. On a GNOME desktop with ``xdg-desktop-portal`` running, that is not a Qt widget at all: Qt asks the portal, the portal starts (or wakes) the GTK implementation over D-Bus, and the dialog can be slow to appear. Every colour picker in the tree was reached through an unguarded ``getColor`` — six of them, none passing ``DontUseNativeDialog``.

records.context: The portal round trip **cannot be reproduced headless**: an offscreen Qt never asks the portal, so no test in this suite can observe the stall or its absence. The restyle work itself is free (``set_line_style`` 0.000 s on a 1,200 point plot) so the wait is in the dialog — and "the portal is what the wait is" is a named, checkable hypothesis to be confirmed on a real display, not something this file proves. What IS proven here, by ``tests/qt/test_colour_picker.py``, is that no call site can ask for the platform dialog any more.

records.source: Lifted out of `spacr.qt.screens.settings_model`, where it was written for the settings panel's chip strip, because a wrapping row is not a settings idea: the regression results header wants one too. records.source: the endless inward travel is two overlapping logarithmic scale windows. The outgoing scale is dropped only once the incoming one has reached the same view, so there is no reset and no microscopic number to lose precision on;
records.translation: अंतहीन भीतर की ओर यात्रा दो एक-दूसरे पर चढ़ी logarithmic scale windows है। बाहर जाने वाला scale तभी छोड़ा जाता है जब आने वाला उसी view तक पहुँच जाए, इसलिए कोई reset नहीं होता और precision खोने के लिए कोई सूक्ष्म संख्या नहीं होती;

records.context: the CPU renderer does true spatial 2x2 supersampling inside one frame -- four samples of the same instant, averaged. The orbit pattern's CPU path jitters across four frames instead, which is cheaper but blends different animation times. That is the reason this one costs four times as much per pixel and renders a quarter of the pixels to pay for it.

records.source: the CPU renderer does TRUE SPATIAL 2x2 supersampling inside one frame -- four samples of the same instant, averaged. The orbit pattern's CPU path jitters across four frames instead, which is cheaper but blends different animation times. That is the reason this one costs four times as much per pixel and renders a quarter of the pixels to pay for it.
records.translation: CPU renderer एक frame के भीतर TRUE SPATIAL (वास्तविक स्थानिक) 2x2 supersampling करता है -- उसी क्षण के चार नमूने, औसत किए हुए। orbit पैटर्न का CPU पाथ इसके बजाय चार frames में jitter करता है, जो सस्ता है लेकिन अलग-अलग animation समयों को मिला देता है। यही कारण है कि इसकी लागत प्रति पिक्सेल चार गुना है और इसकी भरपाई के लिए यह एक चौथाई पिक्सेल रेंडर करता है।

records.context: Why it is a second entry rather than a backend switch. records.source: WHY IT IS A SECOND ENTRY RATHER THAN A BACKEND SWITCH. "Orbit fold" is taken, so this is "Orbit fold (sharp)" -- descriptive of what actually differs rather than a version number.
records.translation: WHY IT IS A SECOND ENTRY RATHER THAN A BACKEND SWITCH (यह backend स्विच के बजाय दूसरी एंट्री क्यों है)। CPU पाथ चार नमूनों को चार frames ACROSS (के पार) jitter करता है, जो चार अलग animation समयों का औसत लेता है; GPU pass एक ही क्षण के भीतर चारों नमूने ले सकता है। ये एक ही चित्र नहीं हैं, इसलिए इन्हें छिपे backend वाले एक विकल्प के रूप में देने का अर्थ होगा कि एक ही सेटिंग दो चीज़ें बनाए। "Orbit fold" पहले से लिया हुआ है, इसलिए यह "Orbit fold (sharp)" है -- संस्करण संख्या के बजाय जो वास्तव में भिन्न है उसका वर्णन।

records.context: ``General`` How much data is loaded and how the cloud is drawn. The sampling setting lives here because it is the answer to the module being laggy on a real dataset -- a screen of a million objects is slow to draw, slow to hit-test, and no more informative than a fifth of them. ``2D`` Data-selection filtering on a scatter: the tools, the shapes, and the clustering that proposes shapes for you. ``3D`` Data-selection filtering in a volume. The settings are here; the workspace they drive is the next piece of work.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_settings#2

records.source: ``General`` How much data is loaded and how the cloud is drawn. The sampling setting lives here because it is the answer to the module being laggy on a real dataset -- a screen of a million objects is slow to draw, slow to hit-test, and no more informative than a fifth of them. ``2D`` Gating on a scatter: the tools, the shapes, and the clustering that proposes shapes for you. ``3D`` Gating in a volume. The settings are here; the workspace they drive is the next piece of work.
records.translation: ``General`` कितना डेटा लोड होता है और cloud कैसे बनता है। sampling सेटिंग यहाँ है क्योंकि यही वास्तविक डेटासेट पर मॉड्यूल के धीमे होने का उत्तर है -- दस लाख ऑब्जेक्ट्स वाली स्क्रीन बनाने में धीमी, hit-test में धीमी, और उनके पाँचवें भाग से अधिक जानकारीपूर्ण नहीं। ``2D`` scatter पर gating: tools, shapes, और वह clustering जो आपके लिए shapes प्रस्तावित करती है। ``3D`` volume में gating। सेटिंग्स यहाँ हैं; जिस workspace को वे चलाती हैं वह अगला काम है।

records.context: Layers are composited with the "over" operator, bottom first. The canvas starts black. Each ticked layer, bottom first, is laid on with its opacity ``a``: where it covers, ``out = out * (1 - a) + colour * a``; where it does not, ``out`` is left alone. An image covers every pixel; a mask covers its objects only, so the background of a mask never dims what is under it. The result is rounded to the nearest whole grey level.

records.source: Layers are composited with the "over" operator, bottom first. The canvas starts black. Each ticked layer, bottom first, is laid on with its opacity ``a``: where it covers, ``out = out * (1 - a) + colour * a``; where it does not, ``out`` is left alone. An image covers every pixel; a mask covers its objects only, so the background of a mask never dims what is under it. The result is rounded to the nearest whole grey level.
records.translation: layers को "over" operator से संयोजित किया जाता है, सबसे नीचे वाली पहले। canvas काले से शुरू होता है। हर टिक की गई layer, सबसे नीचे वाली पहले, अपनी opacity ``a`` के साथ रखी जाती है: जहाँ वह ढकती है, ``out = out * (1 - a) + colour * a``; जहाँ नहीं ढकती, ``out`` अछूता रहता है। छवि हर पिक्सेल ढकती है; मास्क केवल अपने ऑब्जेक्ट्स ढकता है, इसलिए मास्क की पृष्ठभूमि कभी उसके नीचे की चीज़ को धुँधला नहीं करती। परिणाम निकटतम पूर्ण grey level तक गोल किया जाता है।

records.context: The grid in :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.object_settings_grid` edits values; the settings panel is a key-value mapping of widgets, and the workflow reads the widgets. Mounting the grid without a binding would give an application view two answers to the same question -- the table showing what the user typed and ``collect()`` still returning what the widget holds -- and the processing session would silently use the second one, so the saved settings would differ from what the grid shows.

records.translation: :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.object_settings_grid` का ग्रिड मान संपादित करता है; सेटिंग्स पैनल विजेट्स का एक dictionary है, और पाइपलाइन विजेट्स पढ़ती है। बिना binding के ग्रिड लगाने से स्क्रीन के पास एक ही प्रश्न के दो उत्तर होते -- टेबल उपयोगकर्ता का टाइप किया हुआ दिखाती और ``collect()`` अब भी विजेट का मान लौटाता -- और रन चुपचाप दूसरे का उपयोग करता, इसलिए सहेजी गई सेटिंग्स ग्रिड के दिखाए से भिन्न होतीं।

records.context: So the grid never becomes the source of truth. It is a view that writes through: every edit lands in the widget behind it, and the widget stays what the workflow reads. records.context: One widget serves two owners. A segmentation preview has four things worth looking at: the image with the outlines on it, the label masks alone, the flow microscope field of view the masks were pooled from, and the cell probability the flow was thresholded at. Mask generation's live preview showed three of them through a dropdown; the plaque preview showed its own four through tabs, drawn by its own code. This module is the one place both can draw them from, so that a change to how a cell probability is coloured reaches both previews at once.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.segmentation_views#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: One widget serves two owners. A segmentation preview has four things worth looking at: the image with the outlines on it, the label masks alone, the flow field the masks were pooled from, and the cell probability the flow was thresholded at. Mask generation's live preview showed three of them through a dropdown; the plaque preview showed its own four through tabs, drawn by its own code. This module is the one place both can draw them from, so that a change to how a cell probability is coloured reaches both previews at once.
records.translation: एक विजेट दो स्वामियों की सेवा करता है। segmentation प्रीव्यू में देखने योग्य चार चीज़ें होती हैं: outlines वाली छवि, केवल label मास्क, वह flow field जिससे मास्क बने, और वह cell probability जिस पर flow को threshold किया गया। Mask generation का live preview इनमें से तीन dropdown से दिखाता था; plaque प्रीव्यू अपनी चार tabs से दिखाता था, अपने कोड से बनाकर। यह मॉड्यूल वह एक जगह है जहाँ से दोनों इन्हें बना सकते हैं, ताकि cell probability के रंग में परिवर्तन दोनों प्रीव्यू तक एक साथ पहुँचे।

records.context: An owner can replace renderers. The default renderers draw a plain overlay, categorical masks, the flows as Cellpose hands them and the probability on the magma scale. An owner with its own idea of an outline -- the live preview's colour choice and thickness -- registers a renderer for that view with :meth:`SegmentationViews.set_renderer` and keeps the other three. A renderer answers with a picture, with a sentence to show in the picture's place, or with ``None`` for the widget's own "nothing yet" sentence.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.segmentation_views#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: An owner can replace renderers. The default renderers draw a plain overlay, categorical masks, the flows as Cellpose hands them and the probability on the magma scale. An owner with its own idea of an outline -- the live preview's colour choice and thickness -- registers a renderer for that view with :meth:`SegmentationViews.set_renderer` and keeps the other three. A renderer answers with a picture, with a sentence to show in the picture's place, or with ``None`` for the widget's own "nothing yet" sentence.
records.translation: स्वामी renderers बदल सकता है। डिफ़ॉल्ट renderers एक साधारण overlay, categorical मास्क, flows वैसे जैसे Cellpose उन्हें देता है, और probability को magma scale पर बनाते हैं। जिस स्वामी का outline का अपना विचार है -- live preview का रंग चयन और मोटाई -- वह :meth:`SegmentationViews.set_renderer` से उस view के लिए एक renderer पंजीकृत करता है और बाकी तीन रखता है। renderer एक चित्र से, चित्र की जगह दिखाने के लिए एक वाक्य से, या विजेट के अपने "nothing yet" (अभी कुछ नहीं) वाक्य के लिए ``None`` से उत्तर देता है।

records.context: What this module adds is the tie. Two views of the same region are only worth putting side by side if they stay in register: a curator comparing a field with its enhanced self is looking for a difference between them, and a difference in where the two are pointing is the one difference that is not information. :meth:`ZoomableImageView.link_to` makes a group of views share one zoom and one scroll position, so zooming or panning any of them moves all of them.

records.source: What this module adds is the tie. Two views of the same region are only worth putting side by side if they stay in register: a curator comparing a field with its enhanced self is looking for a difference between them, and a difference in where the two are pointing is the one difference that is not information. :meth:`ZoomableImageView.link_to` makes a group of views share one zoom and one scroll position, so zooming or panning any of them moves all of them.
records.translation: यह मॉड्यूल जो जोड़ता है वह जुड़ाव है। एक ही क्षेत्र के दो views को अगल-बगल रखना तभी सार्थक है जब वे सामंजस्य में रहें: किसी फ़ील्ड की उसके enhanced रूप से तुलना करने वाला curator उनके बीच अंतर खोज रहा होता है, और दोनों किस ओर इशारा कर रहे हैं इसमें अंतर ही वह एक अंतर है जो जानकारी नहीं है। :meth:`ZoomableImageView.link_to` views के एक समूह को एक zoom और एक scroll स्थिति साझा करवाता है, इसलिए उनमें से किसी को zoom या pan करने से सभी खिसकते हैं।
